system.effect: Obscuring Terrain is any terrain that can provide reasonable cover from sight-based perception, and prevents a creature from being observed. Any creature in Obscuring terrain gains a bonus to their Stealth skill checks based on their size: Small +4, Medium +2, Large +1. Huge and Gigantic creatures do not gain this bonus.\n\nExamples of Obscurring Terrain: Fog Weather, Tall Grass, Dense Bushes, Deep Water, Smokescreens, Dust Clouds, etc.
